text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The summer camp has arrived once<n>again. A
chance encounter with<n>Maruzensky gives Grass
Wonder the<n>opportunity to speak with her.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After a brief exchange, Maruzensky<n>leaves. Her
shadow looms large in<n>Grass Wonder's eyes.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
However, Grass Wonder has grown<n>much over the
past year. And she<n>isn't finished yet, so let's start
this<n>summer camp!
